title: C4OS Grill Question 032 - File Explorer Add To Chat

questions.label: What should File Explorer `Add to chat` attach?
questions.help: Recommended: attach a C4OS file reference record, not immediate full contents. The runtime adapter can decide whether to inline, summarize, or resolve it later.
options: Selected text if available, otherwise file reference

questions.label: What should Copy Path copy?
questions.help: Recommended: absolute filesystem path, because this is an explicit local desktop tool.

questions.label: Notes or corrections
questions.help: Clarify behavior for directories, binary files, missing files, large files, selected ranges, hidden files, or disabled prompt tagging.
